name: Abhishek Integrations Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Abhishek Integrations Limited is in the business of developing, maintaining & operating of Airports and allied business
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] From FY17 to FY21, company was engaged in developing, operating and maintaining of electrical and mechanical installation at various Airports in India. On March 1st 2021, company took over business of Abhishek Associates and 16 ongoing projects of AAI. Moreover, all project deposits given by firm to AAI were transferred to company

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -5.14%
Company has a low return on equity of 9.32% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 43.8 to 54.1 days.
